text.en:
Air Navigation Act
(Chapter 6 and definition of “authorised person” in paragraph 2(1) of Air Navigation Order)
Designation of Authorised Persons
N 2
G.N. No. S 377/2000
REVISED EDITION 2002
(31st January 2002)
[23rd August 2000]
The Minister for Communications and Information Technology has designated the Division Head and every Airworthiness Officer and Flight Operations Officer of the Airworthiness and Flight Operations Division of the Civil Aviation Authority of Singapore to be an authorised person for the purposes of paragraphs 8(3), 58, 58A, 72A, 73 and 74 of the Air Navigation Order (O 2) and paragraph 2 of Part B of the Ninth Schedule to that Order.
